name: analytics-14
description: GitHub-style activity heatmap of daily deploys over 26 weeks with headline stats and an intensity legend.

files.content:
import { CounterNumber } from "@/registry/designali/ui/counter-number" const weeks = 26 const dayLabels = ["Mon", "", "Wed", "", "Fri", "", "Sun"] function level(week: number, day: number) { const base = Math.sin(week * 0.7 + day * 1.3) + Math.cos(week * 0.31 - day * 0.9) const weekend = day >= 5 ? -1.1 : 0 const ramp = week / weeks const score = base + weekend + ramp * 1.4 if (score < -0.8) return 0 if (score < 0) return 1 if (score < 0.7) return 2 if (score < 1.4) return 3 return 4 } const tones = [ "bg-muted", "bg-primary/20 dark:bg-primary/10", "bg-primary dark:bg-chart-3", "bg-primary dark:bg-primary", "bg-chart-3 dark:bg-chart-1", ] const monthLabels = ["Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov"] export default function Analytics14() { const grid = Array.from({ length: weeks }, (_, w) => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, d) => level(w, d)) ) const activeDays = grid.flat().filter((l) => l > 0).length return (
